audit.whatIsWrong: The text repeatedly calls Volibear's E a stun ('his E hand-of-the-god stun'). Sky Splitter (E, 16s) damages, slows and shields him — the stun is Thundering Smash (Q, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s), which is also an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Advice keyed to the wrong cooldown makes players trade into the real stun and dodge the wrong ability. Frenzied Maul (W, 5s) heals on the second bite and applies on-hit, so Grievous Wounds and attack-speed-aware defence decide extended trades.
audit.corrected: Track Thundering Smash as the stun and gap-close; treat Sky Splitter as slow-plus-shield; buy anti-heal for Frenzied Maul.

audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2 and 3 are given to Volibear though the whys call them even/a coinflip, and 2+ items is 'Skill' against a 22.22% win rate and a why that says you cannot 1v1 him.
audit.why: Neither side has an all-in at 2, and Nautilus's tank-only damage never threatens a fed brawler with a 5s heal.
Spikes read levels 1-2, level 3, his level 6 Stormbringer tower disable, and his first bruiser item — the correct order of this lane's swings.

edits.before: Your Q-pull-root-E combo can win one short trade, but only when his E stun is down — so it's a coinflip, not a win.
edits.after: Your Q-pull-root-E combo can win one short trade, but only when Thundering Smash is down — a coinflip, not a win.

edits.before: Q-pull into passive root into E slow is your one combo that can win a short trade, but only if his E stun is on cooldown.
edits.after: Q-pull into passive root into E slow is your one winning short trade — take it only while Thundering Smash (12s) is on cooldown.

edits.before: Trade only when his E stun is down so he can't cancel your combo and brawl back
edits.after: Trade only while Thundering Smash is down — that stun, not Sky Splitter, cancels you

edits.before: Bait your Q cooldown then E-stun you mid-trade and out-DPS your shield
edits.after: Bait your Q, land Thundering Smash's stun, and out-DPS your shield

edits.before: By 3 your Q-pull into passive-root into E-slow combo can win a short trade — but only if his E hand-of-the-god stun is on cooldown, because if he has it up he just stuns you mid-combo and his W heals through your W shield burn. Through 4-5 he pulls ahead: his empowered Q dash closes any gap you make, and he out-sustains your splash. Do not facecheck a trade into an even Volibear — you do not out-DPS his bite heal.
edits.after: By 3 your Q-pull into passive-root into E-slow combo can win a short trade — but only while Thundering Smash is down, because his Q stun cancels you mid-combo and Frenzied Maul heals through your W burn. Sky Splitter is a slow and a shield, not a stun, so sidestep the ring instead of fearing lockdown from it. Through 4-5 he pulls ahead: his Q closes any gap you make and he out-sustains your splash.

edits.before: His engage. Q-peel around it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His stun and gap-close, 12s — engage only once he has spent it.

edits.before: That is Volibear's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Thundering Smash is an auto reset — the wind-up is the tell, step back before the swing.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Frenzied Maul heals on the second bite every 5s — bring Grievous Wounds.

notes: Real factual error fixed: the text called Sky Splitter (E) a stun in four places. Per Riot's description E is damage + slow + self-shield; the stun and auto-reset is Thundering Smash (Q). Chart rows 1, 2 and 6 flipped as a paired group to match the packet chart and the 22.22% win rate.
